items.body: Summer Walker ’s longtime label/management firm LVRN is countersuing the singer over unpaid commissions and royalties. The R&B singer sued LVRN in August, accusing the Atlanta-based indie music company of skimming money from her music, touring and merch. LVRN denies those claims and, in a new court filing, says Walker is actually the one who breached their 2017 contract by refusing to share key cuts of her earnings. Related Summer Walker Can Break Her Record Deal. But There’s a $50 Million Catch. “Walker has acted in bad faith and been stubbornly litigious,” write LVRN’s lawyers in a Monday (Nov. 9) countersuit, obtained by Billboard . LVRN alleges that Walker hasn’t delivered on several percentage cuts set forth in her contract, including a 7% commission from her Still Finally Over It arena tour this year, a 20% share of her public performance royalties and a 15% management commission on gross ancillary income. The legal documents do not specify which business deals are missing that 15% commission to LVRN. items.title: Slayyyter, Phoebe Bridgers, Billy Strings to Headline Iowa’s 2027 Hinterland Festival
items.summary: The July 30-Aug. 1 event in St. Charles, Iowa will also feature sets from Remi Wolf, Violet Grohl, Malcolm Todd, Zach Top and bbno$, among others.
items.body: The 2027 Hinterland Music Festival will feature headliners Slayyyter, Phoebe Bridgers and Billy Strings, who will take the stage at the July 30-Aug. 1 event in St. Charles, Iowa. Among the other acts booked for the three-day event are Remi Wolf, Caroline Polachek, bbno$, Tiffany Day, Florence Road, Violet Grohl, Sophia Stel and Judith on day one. The July 31 roster will also include Malcolm Todd, The Backseat Lovers, Joshua Slone, underscores, Emma Ogier, Westside Cowboy and Kinji, with Zach Top, Stephen Wilson Jr., Mon Rovia, Wade Forster and Medium Build rounding out the Aug. 1 lineup. There will also be a special performance by Haywire in a Cornfield. Camping is once again at the center of the 12th edition of the music fest at Roaming Hills in St. Charles, just outside Des Moines, with fans able to choose from tent, car or RV options for the weekend. A release announcing this year’s roster notes that after the final main stage set of each night, the action moves to the Campfire Stage for late-night sets in the campground that are open to all attendees. items.title: العقد اقترب من النهاية.. ليفربول يحسم قراره بشأن مستقبل فان دايك
items.summary: حسمت إدارة ليفربول، موقفها من إمكانية تجديد عقد قائد الفريق الأول، الهولندي فيرجيل فان دايك، الذي ينتهي عقده عقب الموسم الجاري.
items.body: حسمت إدارة ليفربول، موقفها من إمكانية تجديد عقد قائد الفريق الأول، الهولندي فيرجيل فان دايك، الذي ينتهي عقده عقب الموسم الجاري.   ويبلغ فان دايك من العمر 35 عامًا، ومع تبقي أشهر قليلة في عقده، وعدم التوصل لاتفاق بشأن التجديد، زادت الشكوك حول مستقبل النجم الهولندي مع ليفربول. وقالت صحيفة " موندو ديبورتيفو ": "أندوني إيراولا، مدرب ليفربول الحالي، وأعضاء مجلس إدارة النادي يعتقدون أن الفريق لا يزال بحاجة إلى قائده". وأعرب إيراولا عن سعادته البالغة بما يقدمه فان دايك لغرفة ملابس ليفربول ، الذي لا يزال أداؤه على أرض الملعب متميزاً للغاية.  علاوة على ذلك، لعب قائد منتخب هولندا جميع دقائق مباريات الموسم الحالي من الدوري الإنجليزي الممتاز، بعد الجولات العشر الأولى. ومن المنتظر أن يقدم ليفربول، عرضا لفان دايك خلال الأيام المقبلة، لتجديد عقده مع النادي الإنجليزي. وتحدث فان ديك، الذي سيغيب عن مباراتي دوري الأمم الأوروبية ضد اليونان (يوم الجمعة في أمستردام) وألمانيا (يوم الاثنين في برلين) بسبب شعوره بعدم الراحة البدنية، عن مستقبله في الساعات الأخيرة وقال بخصوص تجديد عقده المحتمل: "سنرى. أنا لست قلقاً". ناقش الموضوعات والأخبار بشكل أعمق في منتديات كووورة وأوضح قلب الدفاع أنه لا توجد حاليًا أي أخبار بخصوص تجديد عقده. وأضاف فان دايك : "لكن هذا لا يعني وجود أي ضغوط أو ما شابه.…

items.title: بالفيديو.. حسين لبيب يكشف كواليس شركة الكرة في الزمالك.. وسبب الاعتراض على حكم الأهلي
items.summary: كشف حسين لبيب، رئيس نادي الزمالك، عن العديد من الكواليس المثيرة التي تتعلق بالنادي الأبيض، لا سيما فيما يتعلق بشركة الكرة، وكذلك مباراة القمة ضد الغريم التقليدي الأهلي.
items.body: كشف حسين لبيب، رئيس نادي الزمالك، عن العديد من الكواليس المثيرة التي تتعلق بالنادي الأبيض، لا سيما فيما يتعلق بشركة الكرة، وكذلك مباراة القمة ضد الغريم التقليدي الأهلي. وأجرى حسين لبيب حوارًا نادرًا بعد غياب طويل، مع الإعلامي إبراهيم عبدالجواد، عبر قناة "أون سبورت"، للرد على العديد من الاستفسارات التي تدور في أذهان جماهير الزمالك خلال الفترة الماضية. كواليس شركة الكرة في نادي الزمالك في البداية، تحدث حسين لبيب عن سبب رفضه لإطلاق شركة الكرة في نهاية الموسم الماضي، قبل العودة للموافقة عليها مع بداية الموسم الحالي. وقال رئيس الزمالك في هذا الصدد: "في نهاية الموسم الماضي، عُرضت علينا فكرة شركة كرة القدم، وقت وجود المدير الرياضي السابق جون إدوارد، ولم يكن ذلك الوقت المناسب". وأضاف: "في ذلك التوقيت كان لدينا عرض واحد لشركة الكرة، وكنت أريد الوصول إلى أفضل العروض، من خلال تقييم لبعض أنشطة كرة القدم، ولم يكن هناك أي سبب للتسرع". وأردف: "ما أثير عن أن العرض كان من طرف جون إدوارد، وأن هدفه كان السيطرة على نادي الزمالك، غير صحيح، وقد أدى المدير الرياضي أداءً كانت نتيجته التتويج ببطولة الدوري المصري". وواصل: "أنا محظوظ بأن يرتبط اسمي بالتتويج بالدوري المصري في الموسم الماضي، لأنه كان إعجازيًا، حيث إن أكثر المتفائلين كان يرغب فقط في مشاركة الفريق في البطولات الأفريقية". في إطار آخر، قال لبيب: …

items.title: Google Wallet adds digital home keys to open your front door smart lock with a tap
items.summary: There's hands-free unlocking too!
items.body: TL;DR Google Wallet is gaining digital home keys, allowing Android users to unlock compatible smart locks with an NFC tap or hands-free using UWB. The feature supports select Aliro-compatible locks from Aqara, Schlage, and Nuki, with one digital key working across multiple locks in the same home. The functionality is rolling out to Google Home Public Preview users starting today, November 11, with wider availability expected over the coming weeks. Smart locks have already made getting into homes a lot more convenient than it traditionally used to be, and Google is now making that process even more seamless by bringing digital home keys directly into Google Wallet . Starting today, those in the Google Home app’s Public Preview will have the option to add their digital home keys to Google Wallet, allowing compatible smart lock owners to unlock doors by simply walking up to it or tapping their phones against the lock.

items.title: Home Assistant Connect AUX-2 gives your old speakers and TVs a second life for $69
items.summary: That forgotten hi-fi system isn't ready for retirement.
items.body: TL;DR Home Assistant Connect AUX-2 brings older speakers, TVs, and other compatible electronics into the modern smart home. It supports lossless audio, local device control, Bluetooth connectivity, and Z-Wave adapters. The new accessory is available starting November 11 for $69 in the US and €59 in Europe. Not every device needs replacing just because it missed the smart home revolution. That old stereo gathering dust might still sound better than your shiny new wireless speaker , while your TV or heating system could be perfectly capable of following commands without an internet connection. Home Assistant wants to bridge that gap with a new accessory that gives yesterday’s technology a place in today’s connected home. The new Home Assistant Connect AUX-2 is a multi-purpose accessory from Nabu Casa, the company behind official Home Assistant hardware. Rather than adding yet another gadget to your home, Connect AUX-2 is designed to make better use of the ones you already own, bringing older audio systems, TVs, solar equipment, and more into an existing Home Assistant setup.

items.body: TL;DR Google is rolling out a standalone Gemini app to Apple CarPlay globally, bringing Gemini Live to the platform. Unlike its existing Google Maps integration, the standalone app supports broader conversations and Workspace integration. The rollout begins today, November 11. Users need the latest Gemini app on their iPhone and must have used Gemini Live at least once. Google is expanding its AI presence on Apple CarPlay by bringing the standalone Gemini app to the platform starting today, Wednesday, November 11. For reference, CarPlay users have already been able to leverage Gemini’s smarts, albeit only in Maps . The development today takes things a step further. The new standalone app brings access to Gemini Live too, unlocking hands-free conversational assistance throughout your rides. The move has been a long time coming, especially considering that AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, and Copilot are already available on CarPlay.

items.title: Blue Phone gives Google’s Pixel 10 Pro an AI assistant that goes beyond Gemini
items.summary: Why juggle apps when your Pixel can do the juggling?
items.body: TL;DR Y Combinator-backed startup Blue has launched the public beta of Blue Phone, which runs Blue OS on the Pixel 10 Pro and Pro XL. Blue’s AI assistant can work across apps, handle multiple tasks at once, and turn voice recordings into written messages. Blue Phone costs $1,299, but iPhone users can get it for free by trading in their old device within 30 days of purchase. AI assistants can do quite a lot these days. You can ask them to write emails, summarize documents, or help plan a trip. But when it’s time to actually get something done, you still have to jump between apps, look for information, and do much of the work yourself. A startup called Blue wants to change that. Backed by Y Combinator, the company has opened the public beta of its new Blue Phone, which puts an AI assistant at the heart of the smartphone experience. And instead of building an entirely new phone, it’s starting with the Google Pixel 10 Pro and Pixel 10 Pro XL . The big difference is the software. Both phones come with Blue OS, a customized version of Android that lets the AI assistant work across apps and handle tasks for you.

items.title: Google Lens bug traps Chrome users by hiding the close button
items.summary: Google says the bug is fixed, but some users are still stuck.
items.body: TL;DR Google Lens has not been letting Chrome users close out of the side panel. The problem appears to lie with a CSS issue from a Chrome update to the Lens overlay. Google said the issue is fixed but some people still have the issue even after the latest update. Google Lens , the AI-powered search tool that lets you find what you’re looking for with images instead of words, has not been letting Chrome users close out of the feature. That should now be fixed, according to Google, though not everyone affected seems to agree. Reports on Reddit and Google’s Chrome Help Support forums started coming in about a week ago: The “x” to close out of Google Lens was missing for many. None of the usual fixes — closing tabs, shutting Chrome altogether, clearing cache and cookies, and restarting computers — worked to rectify the situation. One user who replied to a post in a Chrome sub shared a temporary solution to closing out of Lens: dragging the tab with Lens open into a new window and then dragging it back into the old window.

items.title: Google Home bug leaves Nest camera notifications without video previews
items.summary: You're not alone if your Nest camera notifications are text-only.
items.body: TL;DR Nest camera users report missing video previews and thumbnails in Android notifications. The issue affects multiple phones and Nest camera models, though previews still work on some other devices. Cameras continue recording normally; it’s just the previews that are missing. We’ve reached out to Google for clarification. Nest camera users are reporting a frustrating bug that’s causing video previews and thumbnails on Android to disappear from notifications. This is leaving users who have gotten in the habit of quickly glancing over their camera feeds through previews with no choice but to open the Google Home app. For those unaware, Google Home’s camera notifications include a thumbnail or a short video preview to highlight what triggered the alert. This makes it easier to determine whether the alert was triggered by something routine or something that needs more attention via the Google Home app. With previews now missing , users are being forced to default to the latter option.

items.body: Credit: Edgar Cervantes / Android Authority TL;DR OpenAI has announced that it will retire ChatGPT Advanced and Standard voice on December 11, 2026. The company is focusing on unifying the voice experience through GPT-Live. Live video and screen sharing will continue to use Advanced voice until GPT-Live has this capability. Earlier this year, OpenAI rolled out a new voice model called GPT-Live . The Gemini Live rival joined ChatGPT Advanced and Standard voice as yet another way to have more natural conversations with the chatbot. As the saying goes, three is a crowd, and OpenAI is ready to do some streamlining. OpenAI has announced that a big change is coming for ChatGPT Voice. On December 11, 2026, the company will be retiring Advanced and Standard voice. The focus will now be on unifying the voice experience through GPT-Live.

items.body: TL;DR Google’s Create My Widget can access personal information through connected Google Workspace services. Existing widgets can be edited directly from the home screen without creating new ones. The feature supports five countries, but UK users miss out on Gemini Connected Apps integration. Creating a home screen widget used to mean finding an app that offered what you wanted and settling for whatever customization options it provided. Google Pixel’s new AI-powered Create My Widget feature flips that around, letting you describe what you need and leaving the design work to AI. But generating a widget is only half the story. Create My Widget is rolling out to the Pixel 10 and Pixel 11 series as part of the November Pixel Drop . The tool lets you create personalized widgets using natural-language prompts or suggested templates, although the Pixel 10a is excluded.

items.body: Credit: Joe Maring / Android Authority TL;DR The team behind GrapheneOS has confirmed that a port of the OS to Pixel 11 phones is almost complete. The group further notes that GrapheneOS on Pixel 11 phones delivers performance that’s “more than good enough.” GrapheneOS is arguably the best Android fork if you value security and privacy. The software originally missed Pixel 11 phones because they lacked support for the Memory Tagging Extensions (MTE) feature. However, MTE is shipping to Pixel 11 devices with Android 17 QPR2, and the team has now revealed more details about the port. The GrapheneOS team announced on social media that GrapheneOS for Pixel 11 phones was nearly complete. Furthermore, the group said that GrapheneOS based on Android 17 QPR2 indeed supports MTE functionality. items.title: The best Nova Launcher alternative isn’t on the Play Store — here’s how to install it
items.summary: You don't need Nova Launcher to enjoy a Nova Launcher-like home screen.
items.body: Although I no longer use it, there’s little doubt in my mind that Nova Launcher is a titan of the Android customization space. This app has seen the meteoric rise of the platform, from Ice Cream Sandwich right through to Android 17, and in that time, the launcher has experienced plenty of ups and downs itself. It was effectively abandonware at one point, then sold, then sold again, and now leaves once-committed users like me questioning its development trajectory . After its initial sale, Nova Launcher’s co-founder stated that an open-source release of the home screen was in the works, and suggested that should he leave the development team, that version would be made broadly available for fans to continue its legacy. More than a year since that post and the launcher’s sale to its current owner, there’s no indication that it’ll ever be open-sourced — at least not in an official capacity.

This huge expanse of space contains hundreds of billions of stars! The smallest galaxies, called dwarf galaxies , are about 1/10th the size of the Milky Way and only contain a few billion stars. items.body: TL;DR Android 17 QPR2 hits stable with today’s new Pixel updates going out. Changes include numerous UI tweaks, security improvements, and accessibility services. Google’s next major release, QPR3, is already in Beta and likely to arrive in the spring. Google’s been previewing its big fall Android update for months now, and after a whole lot of Betas , today we’re finally checking out the full, stable release of Android 17 QPR2. We’ve already highlighted the new features arriving (and those expanding to more devices) as part of Google’s November Pixel Drop , as well as looked over the bug fixes and stability tweaks landing with this month’s Pixel update . But a release this big also has another platform-level component to it, and over on Reddit, Google’s Mishaal Rahman is pointing out all the ways Android is improving with the arrival of QPR2.

items.title: Your Google account will lose its ability to unlock your Nintendo account next year

Once the change goes into effect, you’ll no longer be able to log into your Nintendo account with a Google or Apple account. The target end date is January 26, 2027, but the official end could be delayed “depending on the progress of the system change work.” From Grubhub to ArtStation, you can connect your account to your Google account to make logging in easier. You could even do this with your Nintendo account, but that will no longer be the case soon. Nintendo is putting an end to linking your account with Google or Apple accounts. A newly published support page reveals that Nintendo plans on discontinuing Google and Apple account linking. Once the change goes into effect, you’ll no longer be able to log into your Nintendo account with a Google or Apple account. Users are also losing the ability to create a Nintendo account using Google or Apple. Additionally, the game publisher is putting an end to the My Nintendo Platinum Points mission that rewards users for connecting their accounts.

items.summary: Google Messages joins the (still very small) official list of apps supporting HiLight.
items.body: TL;DR Google introduced its HiLight notification light with Pixel 11 Pro models this year. So far, HiLight has officially supported Phone and WhatsApp calls, as well as Gemini interactions. That’s now expanding to also include Google Messages. Google brought Pixel phones a new hardware feature this year, marking the debut of the HiLight notification light on Pixel 11 models, and now, with the release of the November Pixel Drop, it’s picking up some new functionality. Notification lights have been around since phones weren’t even that smart, but in recent years we’ve seen less and less of them — which is a shame, because they can be genuinely useful. But while we were excited to see Google embrace them again for Pixel 11 phones (well, the Pro models, anyway), so far HiLight has been a little limited in terms of what it can officially do.

items.title: Gboard’s Rambler voice typing expands to the Pixel 10 series
items.summary: No longer a Pixel 11 exclusive.
items.body: TL;DR Gboard’s Rambler voice typing feature is now available on the Pixel 10, 10 Pro, 10 Pro XL, and 10 Pro Fold. Rambler is designed to make sense of your speech by blocking out filler words and providing a polished block of text. The feature has been exclusive to the Pixel 11 series so far, though the third-party app PixelBoard has unofficially unlocked access on other Android devices. Gboard’s latest voice dictation feature, Rambler , is coming to Pixel 10 phones. This feature, which has remained exclusive to the Pixel 11 lineup, is now expanding to cover the company’s 2025 flagships. In addition to Rambler, Google is also bringing a few other Gemini Intelligence features to the Pixel 10 series as part of the November Pixel Drop. With this expansion, Rambler in Gboard is now available on the Pixel 10, Pixel 10 Pro, Pixel 10 Pro XL, and the Pixel 10 Pro Fold in all regions and languages, joining the Pixel 11, 11 Pro, 11 Pro XL, and 11 Pro Fold.

Pixel Search goes beyond traditional Google Search on Android devices, letting users look for files, folders, conversations, Drive, Photos, calendar entries, and more using natural language. The November 2026 Pixel Drop is here, and along with several new features for the broad Pixel lineup, it also expands Pixel 11-exclusive items to older phones. One such feature is the renewed Pixel Search experience , which first arrived with the Pixel 11 series. Now, Google is expanding it to older phones, going all the way back to the Pixel 6 series. The persistent search bar on Pixel phones’ home screens has long offered an experience that is distinct from the rest of Android devices. Unlike other Android devices, search on Pixel phones has traditionally also brought up results from local files and apps alongside web search results. Last year, Google temporarily took that away , but only to introduce an even more far-reaching Pixel Search app when it launched the Pixel 11 phone…

items.title: Google’s November Pixel Drop brings over 12 new features, and Pixel 10 owners are the big winners
items.summary: Pixel Solver, Create My Widget, and Gemini Call Screen lead the way, while Pixel 10 owners finally get Gemini Intelligence.
items.body: Google has announced its November Pixel Drop, and this time, it’s a busy one. The update starts rolling out today, November 10, to all supported Pixel phones, tablets, and smartwatches. It brings a handful of genuinely new tools, including an AI-powered math solver in the Calculator app and a long-awaited widget builder that works from natural language prompts. Pixel Tag, first announced alongside the Pixel 11 series, is also now officially available. Meanwhile, Pixel 10 owners are getting a big chunk of the Gemini Intelligence features that launched with the Pixel 11 series , including Rambler and Gemini’s task automations. Several other features are also expanding to older Pixels and new regions.

items.title: Google rolls out Create My Widget to Pixel 10 and 11 series, but the Pixel 10a misses out
items.summary: You can now use natural language commands to generate widgets, but not on the budget Pixel.
items.body: Credit: Play Store TL;DR Google is rolling out the Create My Widget generative AI tool to Pixel 10 and Pixel 11 series via the November 2026 Pixel Feature Drop. The feature generates Material-style home screen widgets from natural-language text prompts, but notably excludes the Pixel 10a. Google confirmed that Create My Widget is also coming soon to the Pixel Watch 4 and Pixel Watch 5 in select regions. Google’s November 2026 Pixel Feature Drop is officially here, bringing one of the most anticipated personalization tools to your Pixel: Create My Widget. Google announced Create My Widget earlier this year, and is now formally rolling out the generative AI tool to help users design personalized home screen widgets tailored to their everyday needs and workflow. Until now, Create My Widget was surprisingly exclusive to Googlebook laptops , remaining conspicuously absent on Android/Pixel despite a brief sighting through a Google Play Store listing . With the November 2026 Pixel Feature Drop update, rolling out starting today, Pixel users can finally build their own widgets by choosing from curated suggestions or typing simple natural-language prompts.

items.title: Google’s beefing up Calculator with Pixel Solver and Unit Conversion tools
items.summary: How many rods to the hogshead does your car get?
items.body: TL;DR Google’s got a couple upgrades landing for Calculator as part of today’s November Feature Drop. Pixel Solver on Pixel 11 phones uses AI and templates to guide you through math problems. Unit Conversion aims to free you from constantly looking up formulas, and even supports monetary exchange rates. Google’s November Pixel Drop starts going out today, and in addition to seeing the expansion of features like Gboard’s Rambler and Gemini Intelligence , we’re also getting some brand-new ones — including a couple designed to offer a little math assistance: Pixel Solver and Unit Conversion for Google Calculator. We live in a world full of all different kinds of ways to measure things, and converting between them all can sometimes be less intuitive than we’d like — how often have you asked Gemini or Assistant in the kitchen to remind you how many cups are in a quart? While that’s still going to be an option, Google’s now bringing a more manual version of that to its Calculator app .

items.title: After months of waiting, you can finally buy a Pixel Tag
items.summary: You can finally buy Google's first tracker tag.
items.body: Credit: Joe Maring / Android Authority TL;DR Google’s Pixel Tag is finally on sale today (November 11), months after the accessory was first unveiled. The tracker uses the Find Hub network, has an IP67 rating, and delivers precision finding via UWB and Bluetooth Channel Sounding. The Pixel Tag costs $29, although you can also buy a four-pack for $99. Google unveiled the Pixel Tag way back in August alongside the Pixel 11 range. However, the company’s tracker wasn’t actually available to purchase at the time. Thankfully, that changes today as the Pixel Tag is finally on sale. Google’s first tag (unsurprisingly) uses the Find Hub crowdsourced network of Android devices for location tracking. The Pixel Tag also brings an IP67 rating for dust and water resistance, UWB and Bluetooth Channel Sounding for more precise tracking, and a replaceable CR2032 battery that supposedly lasts for over a year.

This feature gave you more customization options for dressing up your home screen. However, Google initially only offered six styles to choose from. items.title: Pixel’s Transit Mode is now automatic, and your daily commutes just got easier
items.summary: Google has announced Transit Mode 2.0, finally removing its biggest limitation.
items.body: TL;DR Google has announced Transit Mode 2.0 with the November Pixel Drop. It can now trigger automatically based on data from your phone’s sensors. It’s available on Pixel 6a and newer phones in all regions and languages. Google introduced Transit Mode on Pixel phones in April this year, and it’s been a handy addition for people who commute on public transport like trains and buses. However, it had one major flaw: you had to manually turn it on every time. If that bothered you as much as it did us, there’s some good news. Google has released the November Pixel Drop with custom icon styles, expanded HiLight support , and more. Among the plethora of updates is Transit Mode 2.0, which can now turn on automatically. Your Pixel phone can use data from its sensors to detect when you’re commuting and activate Transit Mode automatically. This finally brings the feature in line with Pixel’s Driving Mode and Bedtime Mode, which can already activate on their own.

items.title: Google expands Gemini Intelligence and Proactive Gemini Actions with November Pixel Drop
items.summary: Pixel 10 is getting Pixel 11's Gemini Intelligence, automations, and smart suggestions.
items.body: TL;DR Google’s November Pixel Drop brings Gemini Intelligence to the Pixel 10 series, including Rambler, personalized suggestions, and expanded automations. Rambler cleans up voice dictation, while Gemini can now handle more multi-step tasks like ordering groceries, booking rides, and making restaurant reservations. Proactive Gemini Actions adds contextual text summaries, Google Keep grocery list integration, and wider global availability. Ever tried dictating a message, only to spend the next minute deleting all the “ums,” fixing awkward sentences, and wondering whether typing would’ve been faster? Or wished you could simply tell your phone to sort out dinner instead of hopping between apps? Google wants Gemini to take both headaches off your hands, and its latest Pixel Drop is bringing more of that convenience to older Pixel phones. The November Pixel Drop is rolling out today, bringing Gemini Intelligence to the Pixel 10, Pixel 10 Pro, Pixel 10 Pro XL, and Pixel 10 Pro Fold. The expansion brings several capabilities already available on the Pixel 11 series to Google’s previous-generation flagships, including Rambler , personalized suggestions, and expanded automation features.

items.title: Reddit Reviews want to turn user discussions into easily digestible product reviews
items.summary: Bringing user discussions about popular products under one roof.
items.body: TL;DR Reddit has introduced Reddit Reviews, an AI-powered shopping tool that turns community discussions into dedicated product reviews. Reviews include AI-generated summaries, user sentiment, product comparisons, and links to original discussions. Businesses can’t pay for product placements. The feature is rolling out on Android, iOS, and the web in the US, initially covering around 10,000 products, with international expansion planned for 2027. After announcing its transition to a split home feed layout , drawing criticism for its upcoming logged-in-only experience, and even testing ads on the search results page , Reddit is now leveraging its vast collection of real-world user discussions to launch Reddit Reviews. Yes, the feature does exactly what it sounds like. It’s a shopping tool that turns product conversations from across Reddit into dedicated reviews.

items.title: Google Fi’s new Super Network brings automatic 5G switching, Pixel deals, and more
items.summary: Bad 5G signal? Your Pixel might have a clever escape plan.
items.body: TL;DR Google Fi’s new Super Network lets supported Pixel phones automatically switch between two major US 5G networks for better connectivity. Network switching initially works only on Pixel 9 and newer phones using eSIM, while Wi-Fi Auto Connect+ is expanding to select Samsung and Motorola devices. Google is introducing an AI-powered assistant called Ask Fi, along with Pixel 11 offers and discounts on select Google Fi plans. Most of us choose a mobile carrier based on its coverage, data speeds, and pricing. But even the best networks have their weak spots, and there’s usually not much you can do when your phone struggles to find a decent signal. What if your phone could connect to another carrier whenever that happens? That’s exactly what Google Fi is trying to do with its new Google Fi Super Network. The service is bringing back automatic network switching, giving supported phones access to two major US 5G networks instead of relying on just one.

items.title: I lost my keys twice to test the Pixel Tag: It aced downtown but struggled on a quiet trail
items.summary: I deliberately lost my keys in the city and in the woods to see how Google's AirTag rival really holds up.
items.body: Google’s Pixel Tag is finally going on sale, three months after it debuted alongside the Pixel 11 series. It’s the company’s own answer to Apple’s AirTag, and like the AirTag, it leans on a huge crowdsourced network to help you find whatever you attach it to. In this case, that’s Google’s Find Hub network , which the company says spans over a billion Android devices. I’ve been testing the Pixel Tag with my Pixel 11 Pro , and rather than just pinging it around the house, I deliberately lost my keys twice: once on a busy downtown street and once at a quiet, wooded trailhead. Here’s how it held up, and what you should know before you buy one.

items.body: TL;DR Some Google TV owners are experiencing repetitive Google Photos slideshows and freezing in Ambient Mode. The problem affects Chromecast with Google TV and Google TV Streamer devices, although it doesn’t appear to affect everyone. Uninstalling Ambient Mode updates restores normal photo slideshows for some affected devices. But for some users, that personal touch has become a frustrating exercise in repetition, with Ambient Mode recycling the same handful of pictures before freezing altogether.
